chikungunya.name: Chikungunya
chikungunya.timing: The live chikungunya vaccine must be given at least 30 days before travel. The non-live vaccine has no fixed minimum, but earlier is better.

cholera.name: Cholera
cholera.timing: Course should be completed at least a week before travel.

dengue.name: Dengue
dengue.timing: Two doses three months apart, so it needs planning well ahead.

hepatitis-a.name: Hepatitis A
hepatitis-a.timing: No minimum notice. Protection develops within about two weeks, and a dose on the day you fly is still worth having.

hepatitis-b.name: Hepatitis B
hepatitis-b.timing: The very rapid schedule gives protection within about three weeks for adults. Other schedules take one to two months to protect.

japanese-encephalitis.name: Japanese encephalitis
japanese-encephalitis.timing: The course must finish at least a week before possible exposure: about five weeks on the standard schedule, two weeks on the accelerated one.

measles-mmr.name: Measles (MMR)
measles-mmr.timing: Two doses at least a month apart; the second can be brought forward for travel.

menacwy.name: Meningitis ACWY
menacwy.timing: For Hajj and Umrah, the vaccine must be given at least 10 days before arrival in Saudi Arabia.

polio.name: Polio (IPV booster)
polio.timing: For the exit certificate, the dose must be given between 4 weeks and 12 months before you leave the country.

rabies.name: Rabies (pre-exposure)
rabies.timing: Standard course 21 to 28 days; accelerated course 7 days.

tetanus-dtp.name: Tetanus, diphtheria and polio
tetanus-dtp.timing: One injection, effective quickly in anyone previously vaccinated.

tick-borne-encephalitis.name: Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE)
tick-borne-encephalitis.timing: Two doses at least two weeks apart before you travel, so allow a month, or two weeks on the accelerated schedule.

tuberculosis-bcg.name: Tuberculosis (BCG)
tuberculosis-bcg.timing: A tuberculin skin test is needed first from 6 years of age.

typhoid.name: Typhoid
typhoid.timing: At least 2 weeks before travel. A dose closer to departure can still be considered, and we'll explain the limits.

yellow-fever.name: Yellow fever
yellow-fever.timing: Allow at least 10 days before arrival for the certificate to be valid.
